$comment: Machine-readable mirror of docs/study-module-spec.md §5. A source may be used by a content author only if its id appears here. scripts/study-validate.mjs enforces: every block sourceId resolves here, usageMode matches, and no bannedDomain appears in any source URL. Adding a source is a human decision — it needs a reviewed mode and licence.

usageModes.scope_only: Determine exam sections, topic coverage or format only. Do not adapt or reproduce lesson text or questions.
usageModes.reference_only: Cross-check factual propositions, then write a genuinely original explanation. No close paraphrase.
usageModes.open_adaptable: Adaptation permitted only if the exact item/page licence is captured and all attribution / share-alike conditions are followed.
usageModes.public_domain: May be adapted; still cite, and confirm public-domain status for the intended jurisdiction.
usageModes.policy: A licensing/terms page, cited for provenance. Not a content source.
usageModes.prohibited: Do not send to the model, scrape, quote, or use to create app content.
